Annual average CPI-U-RS. Columns YEAR, AVG. Used to compute real_wage (2025 dollars) for summary statistics only.

FRED state statutory minimum wages, Jan 1 values. One row per year; columns STTMINWG + postal code. FG = federal; drop GU, PR. Binding minimum = max(state, FG); NaN or missing column (AL, LA, MS, SC, TN) = no state law. Rates are state only, no local minimums.

D&K Tables 3a (janitors) and 3b (guards), all rows 1-9, transcribed from the paper. One row per term: outsourced, union, parttime, and interactions (row 4). n and r2 repeat within table row. Guard row 8 SEs blank. Janitor rows 2/3 sex labels may be swapped in the paper; see refs/dk_spec.md.
